items.label: Finding home
items.text: I’m studying how weaver ants find home using the surroundings they see.

items.label: Long journeys
items.text: I’m asking how Bogong moths migrate using the night sky and their neighbors.

items.label: A prototype
items.text: I’m making a lightweight, open BLE tracking tag for insects. The board is still a prototype.

items.label: Teaching
items.text: I’m preparing a locust practical and block-course lecture in Konstanz for November–December 2026.
